newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bufete wins Chile contract.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bufete wins Chile contract.

text.p: Mexican builder Bufete Industrial said Monday it had won a $29.5 million fixed-price contract for the procurement and construction of a housing complex in Chile.
Bufete, which said the contract was awarded through its Chilean subsidiary Empresas de Obras y Montajes Ovalle Moore SA, said the complex is at Vina del Mar for the Cooperative Mallen Ltda, "Mallen."
Total construction area is 65,000 square meters and includes several facilities such as eight buildings with 443 departments, seven parking lots and swimming pools.
